Cripta protects against casual snooping. It is not meant against forensic analysis or rooted devices. Deletion uses crypto-shredding (it destroys the file\'s key); physical erasure on flash memory is not guaranteed by the system. The Internet is used only to download videos from links and check for updates: the vault\'s files never leave the device.
